def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    m = len(ops)
    events = []

    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        value = op[3] if op[0] == 1 else -1
        events.append((op[1], i, value))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, i, 0))

    events.sort()

    size = 1
    while size < m:
        size <<= 1

    has_erase = bytearray(2 * size)
    max_colour = [0] * (2 * size)
    counts = {}

    previous = 1
    current_colour = 0
    j = 0

    while j < len(events):
        position = events[j][0]

        if current_colour and position > previous:
            counts[current_colour] = counts.get(current_colour, 0) + position - previous

        while j < len(events) and events[j][0] == position:
            _, index, value = events[j]
            node = size + index
            has_erase[node] = value == -1
            max_colour[node] = value if value > 0 else 0

            node >>= 1
            while node:
                left = node << 1
                right = left | 1

                has_erase[node] = has_erase[left] | has_erase[right]
                if has_erase[right]:
                    max_colour[node] = max_colour[right]
                else:
                    max_colour[node] = max(max_colour[left], max_colour[right])

                node >>= 1

            j += 1

        current_colour = max_colour[1]
        previous = position

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
